description.text: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking an (Associate) Manager Sample Management* to support our Translational Research and Biomarkers team in the development of innovative immunotherapeutic products. You will work in Tuebingen (Germany) in an interdisciplinary environment with colleagues from research and clinical development departments and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. In this role, you will operate at the interface of clinical operations and translational science, ensuring high-quality sample generation to enable biomarker-driven insights. The position is a fixed-term role of 18 months as it covers a maternity leave. YOUR MISSION Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Clinical trial sample management in a GxP environment. Main point of contact for Immatics stakeholders and logistics partners, fostering synergies and transparency. Cooperation with external partners and organization of remote or on‑site trainings, including oversight of contractual obligation fulfilment. Coordination of Sample shipment, handling, and receipt from clinical sites in collaboration with external partners and multiple internal departments. PBMC sample processing at clinical sites and with external partners. Distribution of materials and reagents to external partners. Process streamlining across different sample types. Contribution to the design and continuous improvement of translational sample strategies, ensuring alignment of operational execution with scientific objectives. Support of innovation in sample management through implementation of new technologies, digital solutions, and process optimization measures. Ownership and maintenance of centralized tracking systems to ensure full visibility and traceability of clinical trial samples. Review and contribution to sample‑related sections of clinical trial documents (e.g., laboratory manuals, SOPs), ensuring scientific accuracy and GxP compliance. YOUR PROFILE You hold a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in life sciences, biotechnology, medicine or a related discipline. Knowledge of immunology and/ or oncology is an advantage. We expect a high degree of independent working, analytical reasoning and excellent communication skills in English (at least C1-Level) and preferably German. You have highly developed organizational skills, embrace rapidly changing requirements with an open mind and show a high degree of flexibility in an environment which is marked by a constant striving for excellence and optimization. You approach tasks in a structured, reliable and foresighted manner, combined with an elevated level of individual responsibility, enthusiasm and strong social skills. WHY US? We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME. Driven by our mission to make an impact on the lives of patients with cancer, we are a committed and inspired team and cherish the collegial, highly motivated, and family-friendly atmosphere within Immatics. Our culture allows for a high level of originality, independent thinking, and initiative. We believe in supporting our employees’ professional and social skills: We enable them to join conferences and trainings as well as to enjoy our Immatics benefits – e.g., job bike, job ticket, Health Programs, childcare benefits, relocation allowance, Company summer and winter events. NOTICE *We value diversity and inclusion. Immatics N.V. and all Immatics subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers that evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other characteristics protected by law. ABOUT IMMATICS Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest PRAME franchise with the most PRAME indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics. title: Associate Director Regulatory Affairs – Clinical Lead*

Your main responsibilities as RA Clinical Lead will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Own EU regulatory strategy for assigned programs from First-in-Human through pivotal development and marketing authorization. Pragmatic, risk-based mindset with strong problem-solving skills and a forward-looking, structured approach. High degree of personal responsibility, enthusiasm, team spirit, and reliability. Wir sind weltweit führend in der Entwicklung von zielgerichteten Therapien gegen PRAME. Wir sind weltweit führend in der Entwicklung von zielgerichteten Therapien gegen PRAME, einer Tumorzielstruktur, die in mehr als 50 Krebsarten vorkommt.
